title: Cardinal bound from a transcendence basis of an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $F\to E$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], with $E$ algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $v:I\to E$ be a transcendence basis over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis]. Then $$|E|\leq\max(\max(|F|,|I|),\aleph_0).$$ Here $|S|$ denotes set cardinality and $\aleph_0=|\mathbf N|$; cardinalities are lifted to a common universe. No countability, finite-generation, or nonemptiness assumption on $I$ is imposed.
